name: Michael Madhusudan Dutt
role: Poet-dramatist and pioneer of modern Bengali literary form
contribution: He transformed Bengali poetry and drama through formal innovation, including major work in blank verse and epic composition.
context: His career unfolded during the 19th-century transition under colonial rule when Bengali literary modernity was being formed.
impact: He became a key pillar of modern Bengali literary aesthetics and intellectual culture.
highlight: A formal innovator who reshaped Bengali poetic language.
seoTitle: Michael Madhusudan Dutt: Pioneer of Modern Bengali Poetry
seoDescription: Learn how Michael Madhusudan Dutt transformed Bengali poetry and drama through blank verse, epic composition, and formal literary innovation.
shortAnswer: Michael Madhusudan Dutt was a Bengali poet and dramatist who reshaped modern Bengali literary form through blank verse and epic composition.
